desc: Satisfy your sweet tooth cravings with Betty Crocker Fudge Brownie Mix. This indulgent brownie mix made with Dutch Cocoa is the quick and easy way to create moist, delectable brownies the whole family will love by adding just a few ingredients. Whip up this brownie baking mix in minutes by simply adding water, oil and an egg. Impress friends and family at your next gathering or brighten up a Tuesday with these decadent baked goods. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes. And today, you can still find those same products you grew up with on grocery shelves.
features:
BROWNIE MIX: Bake a delicious dessert with this supreme brownie mix that makes mouthwatering treats

QUICK AND EASY: Make brownies by just adding a few ingredients to baking mix as directed and popping in the oven

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare brownie mix as is or explore the many Betty Crocker creative recipes

RICH FUDGY TASTE: A delicious, moist and fudgy brownie dessert

SPECIAL OCCASION TREATS: Serve chocolatey baked goods for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

BOX TOPS FOR EDUCATION PARTICIPATING PRODUCT: Give back to schools with Betty Crocker; Download the Box Tops App to learn more & start earning cash for your school or a school in need
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Palm Oil, Salt, Corn Starch, Artificial Flavor, Nonfat Milk.
